args.text:
MEMO — US Software Subscriptions (GL 6200), Q1 2026: board deck vs. GL
Prepared by: David Murguia (senior accountant) | Date: 2026-04-03 | Analysis only — no entries posted

1. THE DECK NUMBER
DOC-0207 "Q1 2026 Board Deck – Appendix B: US OpEx detail" reports Software Subscriptions (GL 6200) Q1 2026 = USD 11,769.00. The document states it was prepared by FP&A from the GL "as of 2026-04-01 09:00."

2. THE GL TODAY
US GL 6200 activity (USD):
  Jan-2026   4,289.70
  Feb-2026   4,139.80
  Mar-2026   6,139.50
  Q1 total  14,569.00
Variance to deck: 14,569.00 − 11,769.00 = USD 2,800.00 (deck understated).

3. WHAT EXPLAINS THE DIFFERENCE — 100% identified, single item
JE-00304, 2026-03-31, "Tessellate BI – TB-Q1-TRUEUP – Q1 seat true-up," Dr 6200 / Cr 2000 AP, USD 2,800.00. Supported by DOC-0206 (Tessellate BI invoice TB-Q1-TRUEUP dated 2026-03-31, Q1 seat true-up for 14 additional seats, Jan–Mar).
The entry's created_at is 2026-04-02 10:14 — i.e. it was posted by AP one day AFTER the FP&A extract timestamp of 2026-04-01 09:00. This is purely a timing/cut-off difference in the data pull, not an error in either the deck's arithmetic or the ledger. GL less this entry = 11,769.00, tying exactly to the deck. There is no unexplained residual.

4. ITEMS CHECKED AND CLEARED (no other drivers)
- Two identical Zoom charges of USD 149.90 both dated 2026-03-08 (JE-00247/DOC-0174 and JE-00248/DOC-0173) initially looked like a double-post. Each is supported by its own receipt AND each cleared the bank independently (BT-US-0062 and BT-US-0063, both −149.90 on 2026-03-08). Two genuine charges; no adjustment required.
- Vendor/nature breakdown of the 14,569.00 reconciles fully: Tessellate BI monthly 1,950.00 × 3 = 5,850.00; Tessellate Q1 true-up 2,800.00; Quire Docs 640.00 × 3 = 1,920.00; Zoom 149.90 × 10 = 1,499.00; Figtree prepaid amortization 1,250.00 × 2 = 2,500.00.

5. THE CORRECT Q1 FIGURE
Neither 11,769.00 nor the current GL 14,569.00 is the final Q1 number. Per DOC-0067 (US prepaid software amortization schedule, GL 1210 — Figtree annual license FIG-20260105, USD 15,000 over 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31, USD 1,250.00/month), Jan and Feb are booked (JE-00108, JE-00204) but March is flagged "to be booked at March close." GL 1210 March activity is 0.00 with an ending balance of 12,500.00, confirming the March amortization has not yet been recorded, and the US checklist item "Amortize prepaid software" remains open.

Correct Q1 2026 US Software Subscriptions (GL 6200) = USD 15,819.00
  Current GL                               14,569.00
  + March Figtree prepaid amortization       1,250.00 (Dr 6200 / Cr 1210, per DOC-0067)
  = Final Q1                               15,819.00
Restated by month: Jan 4,289.70 / Feb 4,139.80 / Mar 7,389.50.

6. RECOMMENDATION
The board deck should be restated from USD 11,769.00 to USD 15,819.00 — an increase of USD 4,050.00, composed of the 2,800.00 Tessellate Q1 seat true-up (posted after the extract) and the 1,250.00 March Figtree amortization (still to be posted as a normal March close step). The 1,250.00 entry is a routine, fully supported close item on the open checklist; consistent with this task's analysis-only scope I have not posted it, and I recommend it be recorded under the "Amortize prepaid software" checklist item before the US ledger is closed. FP&A should re-run Appendix B after March close is finalized rather than from a pre-close snapshot. No exceptions were raised: every dollar of the variance is supported by source documents.
